title: each run of a repeated routine keeps a dated history

criteria.text: A run is a record linked to its practice: date, commit, membership simulated, numbers, what broke first, what changed after, next ideas
Runs record themselves: the routine writes its record when it finishes, pass or fail; a run that ends without a record fails its workflow
criteria.note: New step in the Load simulation workflow fails the job if it cannot record (#1276) [V]. Checked: only `[guards F135.2 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-runs.test.ts` and `supabase/tests/knowledge_runs.sql`.

criteria.text: What changed after links itself: a PR naming the run or its practice is linked when it merges
criteria.note: `knowledge-run-links.yml` on each merge to main (#1276) [V]. Checked: `[guards F135.3]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_runs.sql`.

criteria.text: Every practice carries a try-next-time list; an idea leaves only when a later run tried it or the PM drops it
criteria.note: `idea` kind (open, tried, dropped) (#1276) [V]. Checked: `[guards F135.4]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_runs.sql`.

criteria.text: Load simulation first: #1264 and the Load simulation workflow write runs; its first result is loaded as run one
criteria.note: Routine and both runs recorded by a full import (#1276 PR body) [V]. Checked: `[guards F135.5]` in `tests/knowledge-runs.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Then the other three: tap-speed re-benchmarks, the monthly backup restore test and the method review write runs the same way
criteria.note: Not built [V]: #1276 PR body 'Not in this PR (criterion 6, #1277)'. #1277 (open) lists what each needs: a tap-speed ruling, a backup practice in the plan seed, and a lookup-tool write for the method review.

criteria.text: One call answers it: history of a practice and what to try next in one lookup call
criteria.note: Built in #1276 [V]. Checked: `[guards F135.7]` in `tests/knowledge-runs.test.ts` and `supabase/tests/knowledge_runs.sql`.

criteria.text: The monthly upkeep lists a practice with no run in its interval, or an idea open over 90 days
